title: Simulation rules
description: The hand-authored rules of DESIGN.md §0 — 'as few as possible, and hand-authored with extreme care'. §13's balance philosophy points here first: an overpowered outcome is fixed by a coefficient in this file or a property in materials.json, never by a special case in the resolver. Nothing here may name a material, an item or a creature.

reference_temp.description: The temperature at which authored hardness values are quoted.

fracture_k.description: §4.3 step 3's k: how far past hardness a material must be pushed before it separates, scaled by toughness.

blunt_k.description: Energy density per unit toughness at which a broad impact breaks a part regardless of stress. §4.3 promises a maul that beats brittle armour without denting it; a pure stress test cannot produce that, because a large contact area is exactly what keeps stress low.

strike_return_k.description: Share of a blow returned into the striking part, scaled by the hardness ratio of the two materials.

radiant_k.description: Heat exchanged between separate entities. Conduction along an assembly cannot carry a fire from a burning tree to the wolf beside it, and §4.3 promises exactly that.

soften_k.description: How much of a material's hardness is lost between reference temperature and its melting point.

cascade_generations.description: §4.3 bounds cascades to guarantee termination; the document's figure is 3.

swing_arc.description: Half-angle of the arc a swing sweeps, in radians. A target outside it is behind you, which is what makes facing matter.
